Yes: the matching paper is Structural Segmentation for Brazilian Legal Document Retrieval by Leandro Carísio Fernandes and coauthors [1]. It studies structural segmentation for Brazilian legal document retrieval, representing legal acts as collections of chunks based on their hierarchical structure rather than indexing each document as a single unit [1].

The paper compares a full multi-layer hierarchy with simpler chunk-based variants centered on core chunks such as articles and non-normative components, with different amounts of context [1]. It finds that structural segmentation improves dense retrieval over whole-document indexing, but does not consistently help lexical retrieval; it also reports that full hierarchy is unnecessary, since core chunks enriched with document metadata can match or outperform it [1].
